name: Synergy Food Group
old_description: Soon you’ll be able to meet one‑on‑one with our licensed dietitians for nutrition plans tailored to your goals, your lifestyle, and your health needs. This new service will bring approachable, practical support to individuals seeking everyday wellness, chronic condition management, or simply a clearer path to healthier eating.
about:
Synergy Food Group operates from Columbia, Kentucky, as a mission-driven food manufacturer focused on improving nutrition access nationwide. The company produces Medically Tailored Meals (MTMs) and a range of frozen, shelf-stable, and sous-vide meal solutions for healthcare, education, government, and retail channels.

Its production capabilities include frozen prepared meals, shelf-stable emergency meal kits, ready-to-heat sous-vide proteins, and specialized endurance meals for performance athletes. The facility runs at a capacity of 500,000 meals per week, supporting large-scale food service contracts for K-12 districts, higher education, senior living programs, and emergency response partners.

Customers span healthcare systems and insurers seeking MTMs for chronic condition management and GLP-1 patient support, school nutrition programs, senior living communities, federal, state, and local agencies, disaster relief organizations, retail chains, pharmacies, and collegiate athletic departments. Each partner receives a dedicated clinical account team that includes a registered dietitian.

The company emphasizes clinical reliability at volume, citing temperature control from production to last-mile delivery, third-party quality audits, and an outcomes-driven partnership model rather than transactional contracts. Its stated mission is to make nutritious, medically aligned meals accessible to every community it serves.
